{"artifact":"SmeDossierEnvelope","schema_version":"0.4.0","stage_id":"02.dossier_sections","probe":"rdmv-wv-class-e","lineage":{"input_manifest_sha256":"6be9f36e8ef7a6fe94227d95664424f3e05edddd22b952e9b03441a9d981a889","candidate_lineage_id":"2026-10-28-rdmv-wv-class-e:lineage:69","source_registry_sha256":"2261abaab8e2b1aaff5b8a336e3bfcf845adaa75847f0210442061783d7f9afb","source_liveness_sha256":"9a1fb68777f5e9d5c4b27899084cc233b265410fee506dfe6554447a61ea026e"},"envelope_scope":{"kind":"partial_chunk","assigned_section_ids":["C2"],"chunk_index":1,"chunk_total":1},"section_char_limit":12000,"sections":[{"section_id":"C2","chunk_id":"C2.01","merge_seq":1,"domain":"Emergencies and roadside assistance","heading":"C2 — Confusables and KG hints, Emergencies and roadside assistance","learner_facing":false,"markdown":"## C2 — Confusables and KG hints, Emergencies and roadside assistance

FACT_ID: sec16-R01 | anchor: A02
In a skid you steer in the direction the rear is sliding and stay off the brakes unless a collision looms, whereas with a stuck gas pedal you shift to neutral or push in the clutch, brake and shut off the ignition [A02].
Why it matters: group emergency-maneuvers; difficulty high; prereq sec16-F12; confusables sec16-F12, sec16-F13 [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0081]

FACT_ID: sec16-R02 | anchor: A02
In a brake failure you pump the pedal quickly, drop to a lower gear and apply the parking brake while holding its release so a rear-wheel lock can be eased off [A02].
Why it matters: group emergency-maneuvers; difficulty medium; prereq sec16-F09; confusables sec16-F09, sec16-F10 [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0081]

FACT_ID: sec16-R03 | anchor: A03
An engine fire is smothered with dirt or sand, never water, and once it is out of control you retreat at least one hundred feet because the tank may explode [A03].
Why it matters: group fire; difficulty medium; prereq sec16-F17; confusables sec16-F17 [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0082]

FACT_ID: sec16-R04 | anchor: A03
Faced with a vehicle in your lane you move right, slow, sound the horn and flash the lights, but you never swing into the lane the other driver left [A03].
Why it matters: group oncoming-vehicle; difficulty medium; prereq sec16-F18; confusables sec16-F18, sec16-F15 [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0082]

FACT_ID: sec16-R05 | anchor: A03
When headlights fail you leave the road at once if it is lighted, try the parking lights, signals or flashers if it is dark, and stay on the roadway only when every light has failed, slowing enough to pull off safely [A03].
Why it matters: group lights; difficulty high; prereq sec16-F16; confusables sec16-F16 [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0082]

FACT_ID: sec16-R06 | anchor: A03
Jumper cables join positive post to positive post, but the live battery's negative goes to the dead vehicle's engine block or frame rather than to the dead battery's negative post, and the two vehicles must not touch [A03].
Why it matters: group jump-start; difficulty high; prereq sec16-F20; confusables sec16-F20, sec16-F21 [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0082]

FACT_ID: sec16-R07 | anchor: A04
First aid runs bleeding first, breathing second, shock third and broken bones fourth, and the victim stays lying down unless danger requires a move [A04].
Why it matters: group first-aid; difficulty high; prereq sec16-F25; confusables sec16-F24, sec16-F25 [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0083]

FACT_ID: sec16-R08 | anchor: A05
A crash with injury, death or property damage of one thousand dollars or more must be reported to law enforcement, yet a passerby should not stop at a crash at all unless involved or able to help [A05].
Why it matters: group crash-duties; difficulty medium; prereq sec16-F28; confusables sec16-F28, sec16-F29 [A05]
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0084]

FACT_ID: sec16-R09 | anchor: A07
A littering conviction can cost fifty to one thousand dollars, up to sixty days in jail or at least thirty hours of litter removal, with points possible as well [A07].
Why it matters: group littering; difficulty medium; prereq sec16-F33; confusables sec16-F33 [A07]
Source: [A07 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0087]

FACT_ID: sec16-R10 | anchor: A01
A healthy brake pedal stops firmly within half its travel, a spongy pedal suggests air in the line, and a pedal that keeps sinking through a ten count suggests a leak [A01].
Why it matters: group vehicle-checks; difficulty medium; prereq sec16-F01; confusables sec16-F01, sec16-F02 [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0080]

FACT_ID: sec16-R11 | anchor: A01
After a blowout you steer straight and ease off the gas without braking until control returns, and because under-inflation causes most blowouts tire pressure is checked monthly while the tires are cold [A01].
Why it matters: group tires; difficulty medium; prereq sec16-F07; confusables sec16-F04, sec16-F07, sec16-F08 [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0080]

FACT_ID: sec16-R12 | anchor: A06
A genuine Courtesy Patrol vehicle is a white pickup with blue and gold logos and a flashing orange bar light, and its badged driver approaches on the passenger side [A06].
Why it matters: group courtesy-patrol; difficulty low; prereq sec16-F32; confusables sec16-F31, sec16-F32 [A06]
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0085]

FACT_ID: sec16-R13 | anchor: A03
When steering fails you ease off the gas and brake gently if the vehicle holds its lane, but brake hard if it heads off the road or toward people or another vehicle [A03].
Why it matters: group emergency-maneuvers; difficulty medium; prereq sec16-F15; confusables sec16-F15, sec16-F14 [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0082]
